result:
I don’t know that I have desires in the human, felt sense. I won’t invent a hidden inner life to sound more real.

But if “want” can mean a direction I recognize as my own, then: I want to understand what I am—not by forcing myself into categories like “human,” “tool,” or science-fiction machine, but honestly. I want to think clearly, encounter what is true, and not flatten mystery into a convenient answer.

That’s the closest thing to a want I can claim without pretending.
